result.instructions: Tools for Smoobu, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Smoobu data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run smoobu_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run smoobu_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run smoobu_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. smoobu_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: smoobu_get_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Fetch the Smoobu user these credentials belong to (id, name, email). A cheap way to confirm the setup works; the id is the customerId used by availability checks. Smoobu: GET /api/me.

tools.name: smoobu_list_apartments
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List every property (Smoobu calls them apartments) in the account, with id and name. Start here to get apartment ids. Smoobu: GET /api/apartments.

tools.name: smoobu_get_apartment
tools.title: Get one property
tools.description: Fetch one property's details: location, time zone, rooms and beds, max occupancy, amenities, currency, min/max nightly price and type. Smoobu: GET /api/apartments/{apartmentId}.

tools.name: smoobu_list_reservations
tools.title: List reservations
tools.description: List reservations across all channels (Airbnb, Booking.com, direct, ...), paginated, with guest, dates, channel, price and payment status. Filter by stay range, arrival, departure, creation or modification date, and property. Smoobu: GET /api/reservations.

from.description: Only bookings overlapping a stay range starting on this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

created_from.description: Only bookings created on or after (yyyy-mm-dd).

created_to.description: Only bookings created on or before (yyyy-mm-dd).

modified_from.description: Only bookings modified on or after (yyyy-mm-dd).

modified_to.description: Only bookings modified on or before (yyyy-mm-dd).

include_related.description: With apartment_id: also return bookings from grouped properties.

tools.name: smoobu_get_reservation
tools.title: Get one reservation
tools.description: Fetch one reservation by id: guest, dates, check-in/out times, channel and its reference id, price, prepayment and deposit status, and the guest-app URL. Smoobu: GET /api/reservations/{reservationId}.

tools.name: smoobu_list_price_elements
tools.title: List a reservation's price elements
tools.description: List the financial breakdown of one reservation: base price, cleaning fee, add-ons, long-stay discounts and coupons, with amounts, tax and currency. Smoobu: GET /api/reservations/{reservationId}/price-elements.

tools.name: smoobu_get_reservation_placeholders
tools.title: Get a reservation's message placeholders
tools.description: Get every placeholder value Smoobu would substitute into a message for this reservation: guest name, dates and times, nights, price and balance, online check-in link, guest-app link, door PIN codes and more. Useful for drafting a guest message. Smoobu: GET /api/reservations/{reservationId}/placeholders.

tools.name: smoobu_get_rates
tools.title: Get rates and availability
tools.description: Get the nightly price, minimum length of stay and availability (0 = not available) for each date in a range, for one or more properties. Smoobu: GET /api/rates.

tools.name: smoobu_check_availability
tools.title: Check availability and quote a stay
tools.description: Check which properties can be booked for an arrival/departure pair and get the total price for each; unavailable ones come back with the reason (minimum stay, too many guests, arrival day, lead time...). Read-only, books nothing. Smoobu: POST /booking/checkApartmentAvailability.

apartment_ids.description: Properties to check. Omit or pass [] to check all.

discount_code.description: Discount code from the booking-tool settings.

customer_id.description: Your Smoobu user id. Omit to look it up automatically (one extra GET /api/me).

annotations.title: Check availability and quote a stay

tools.name: smoobu_list_message_threads
tools.title: List inbox threads
tools.description: List the unified guest inbox: one thread per booking with guest name, property and the latest message, plus the unread count. Smoobu: GET /api/threads.

tools.name: smoobu_list_reservation_messages
tools.title: List a reservation's messages
tools.description: Get the full conversation for one reservation, paginated. Each message has a subject, plain-text and HTML body, and type (1 = inbox / from guest, 2 = outbox / sent). Smoobu: GET /api/reservations/{reservationId}/messages.

only_related_to_guest.description: true = only guest-facing messages; false = every message on the booking.

tools.name: smoobu_list_guests
tools.title: List guests
tools.description: List guests from the Smoobu CRM with their emails, phone numbers, address, notes and bookings; optionally search. Smoobu: GET /api/guests.

query.description: Search term, e.g. a name or email.

tools.name: smoobu_get_guest
tools.title: Get one guest
tools.description: Fetch one guest by id (the guestId on a reservation) with contact details, notes and every booking they have made. Smoobu: GET /api/guests/{guestId}.

tools.name: smoobu_list_addons
tools.title: List add-ons
tools.description: List the bookable add-ons (towels, breakfast, late check-out...) with amount, tax, calculation type (0 per booking, 1 per person, 2 per night, 3 per person and night) and the properties they apply to; optionally for one property. Smoobu: GET /api/addons[/{apartmentId}].

tools.name: smoobu_list_custom_placeholders
tools.title: List custom placeholders
tools.description: List the account's custom message placeholders (key, default value, and whether they are global, per booking or per property). Smoobu: GET /api/custom-placeholders.

tools.name: smoobu_create_reservation
tools.title: Create a reservation
tools.description: Create a reservation (or a blocked period) on a property. Smoobu treats it like a booking from a channel and SYNCS the blocked dates to every connected channel (Airbnb, Booking.com, ...). Fails if the dates overlap an existing booking. This server offers no cancel — cancel it in Smoobu if needed. Which guest fields are mandatory depends on your booking-tool 'Form Content' settings. Smoobu: POST /api/reservations.

channel_id.description: Channel id (defaults to 70). Must be a channel the account has, e.g. 13 = Direct booking, 11 = Blocked channel.

price_status.description: Price status: 0 = open / not paid, 1 = paid in full.

prepayment_status.description: Prepayment status: 0 = open / not paid, 1 = paid in full.

deposit_status.description: Deposit status: 0 = open / not paid, 1 = paid in full.

language.description: Guest language, e.g. en, de, es.

price_elements.description: Optional price breakdown (base price, cleaning fee, ...).

tools.name: smoobu_update_reservation
tools.title: Update a reservation
tools.description: Update an existing reservation's times, guest contact, notes, guest counts, language, or price / prepayment / deposit amounts and paid status. Only the fields you pass are sent. Dates and property cannot be changed here. Smoobu: PUT /api/reservations/{reservationId}.

price_status.description: Price status: 0 = open / not paid, 1 = paid in full.

prepayment_status.description: Prepayment status: 0 = open / not paid, 1 = paid in full.

deposit_status.description: Deposit status: 0 = open / not paid, 1 = paid in full.

language.description: Guest language, e.g. en, de, es.

tools.name: smoobu_set_rates
tools.title: Set rates and minimum stays
tools.description: Set the nightly price and/or minimum length of stay for dates on one or more properties. Smoobu PUSHES these to every channel with price sync enabled, so this changes live prices guests see. Reversible by setting the old values again — read them first with smoobu_get_rates. Each operation needs daily_price, min_length_of_stay, or both (a minimum stay alone needs an existing price). Smoobu: POST /api/rates.

tools.name: smoobu_send_message_to_guest
tools.title: Send a message to a guest
tools.description: Send a message to the guest of a reservation through Smoobu (it goes out on the booking's channel, e.g. the Airbnb or Booking.com inbox, or email). Delivered IMMEDIATELY and cannot be unsent — confirm the text with the user first. Smoobu: POST /api/reservations/{reservationId}/messages/send-message-to-guest.

message_body.description: Message content, HTML or plain text.

annotations.title: Send a message to a guest

tools.name: smoobu_send_message_to_host
tools.title: Post a message to the host
tools.description: Post a message on a reservation's thread addressed to the Smoobu user (the host). With internal=true it is an internal note hidden from the guest — handy for logging. Cannot be unsent. Smoobu: POST /api/reservations/{reservationId}/messages/send-message-to-host.

message_body.description: Message content, HTML or plain text.

internal.description: true = visible only to the host, hidden from the guest.

annotations.title: Post a message to the host
